fix(daemon): the draw's reserve holds a draw descheduled on a busy machine (candybar-launch-q7o7.qjw)

On CI's runner, its cores shared with the other process-tier suites, a cold
draw that does a few ms of work reads up to 48 ms of wall time, failing the
40 ms reserve. Reproduced locally with every core busy: median 2 ms, p99 48 ms.
A larger reserve costs only more pending values; a smaller one blanks the bar.
